mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volume_rank (as_of, rnk, symbol, name, market, volume, last_price, prev_close, change_rate) VALUES (#{asOf}, #{rnk}, #{symbol}, #{name}, #{market}, #{volume}, #{lastPrice}, #{prevClose}, #{changeRate})
mapper.select: SELECT as_of, rnk, symbol, name, market, volume, last_price, prev_close, change_rate FROM volume_rank ORDER BY rnk
